currentUserGoal: Make the Android home-screen icon use the hand-touching-grass artwork and get it live for an Android play tester.
workCompleted: Replaced the old pale/transparent launcher icon treatment with a new full-bleed dark meadow icon using the existing hand-on-grass class artwork as the central mark.
Added separate versioned normal and maskable PWA icon files so Android can choose a safe adaptive icon without cropping or washing out the artwork.
Regenerated legacy icon filenames, apple-touch-icon, favicon PNG, and favicon.ico so cached older references still point to improved artwork.
Updated the web manifest to reference separate `any` and `maskable` icon assets.
Added a manifest query string in `index.html` to nudge browsers away from a cached manifest.
knownIssues: Android launchers may cache installed home-screen icons. Existing testers may need to remove and re-add the PWA/shortcut, or reinstall it, before the new icon appears.
nextRecommendedSteps: Commit and push the icon/manifest/handoff changes.
Wait for the production deployment to become READY and verify `https://grasstouchingsimulator.com/site.webmanifest?v=android-icon-2` references the new versioned icons.
doNotRevert: Keep the separate maskable icon entries; Android adaptive icons need full-bleed background art plus centered safe-zone content.
currentGitStatus: Before staging: intended changes are icon assets, `index.html`, `public/site.webmanifest`, `scripts/generate-pwa-icons.py`, and this handoff; unrelated untracked docs/artifacts remain from earlier sessions.
